scope: Retained native package tracks to bounded event-quality evaluation

mission.goal: Close the native-output-to-quality-evaluation gap without hand-authored candidate scores or invented timing.

authority.git: User explicitly authorized meaningful direct-main GitHub commits without PRs; expected-head non-force updates preserve concurrent work.

situation_roots.source_custody: Retained PackageAnalysisReport, original RetainedFileImport, authenticated per-frame capsules, current privacy and ledger head.
situation_roots.assumptions: Capture hints and labelled coverage are caller declarations; neither becomes a clock or CoverageWitness attestation.

published_checkpoints.change: Bounded cancellable evaluator, production native-track projection, custody owner, existing-store opening mode, contracts and digest domains.
Retained-package CLI, complete metadata/provenance output, parser/process contracts, product documentation and verification handoff.

cases.question: Can retained native outputs enter quality evaluation without hand-authored score/timing candidate TSV?
cases.finding: Implemented a direct complete-track projection from retained detections using actual tracker confirmation semantics.
cases.qualification: Production-source pure projection tests execute; native custody tests remain unexecuted.
cases.stop_rule: No guessed clocks/cadence, selected track subset, class upgrades, zone semantics or activation authority.

cases.question: Can evaluation reopen an existing deployment without reconciling unrelated pending external effects?
cases.finding: Added a crate-private existing-store mode which keeps publisher locking/recovery and journal/layout checks while skipping effect reconciliation.
cases.qualification: Source-reviewed only; local publisher recovery can still write housekeeping state.
cases.stop_rule: Never initialize absent roots or missing required journals.

contracts.candidate: First actually confirmed assigned observation; exact detector row, capture instant and F32 score bits. No later substitution.
contracts.scope: One clip, one native class, unzoned labels; every track accounted for including unconfirmed and out-of-window tracks.
contracts.time: At least two strictly increasing singleton capture instants; matching stream and clock; operator_assumption source label; clip within [first capture,last capture+1ns).
contracts.continuity: Reject source/sequence gaps and non-container omissions affecting the analysed range; preserve native dimension epochs and forbid cross-epoch tracks.
contracts.revalidation: Two complete source observations and identical derived projections, current privacy and final authority anchor under one cumulative source allowance.
contracts.identities: Derived from retained package/model/graph/head pins, exact tracking recipe and production projection/tracker/evaluator source identities.
contracts.output: Metadata-only completed native owner, not inference, calibration, event publication or effect dispatch.
contracts.legacy: Existing manual TSV evaluator behavior and successful report digests remain unchanged.

budgets.cancellation: ReplayCx checkpoints own lifecycle finalization; pure extraction and matching poll cooperatively. Bounded sort/hash operations remain indivisible.

validation.tested_sources: Actual production evaluator, extracted package record/observation types and sample-confirmation helper, and pure native package projection.
validation.source_review: Independent reviews of the production owner, opening mode, shared real JPEG/numeric package fixture, integration/process tests, dependencies and module paths found no blocking API issue.
validation.formatting: Changed Rust files formatted with the pinned toolchain; git diff --check completed.
validation.limitation: Full reference/CLI execution remains blocked by the unchanged Asupersync 0.5.0 compilation limitation. Earlier full and bounded metadata builds received SIGKILL; this session did not retry that dependency or weaken gates.
validation.qualification: Passing pure-source contracts do not establish custody/CLI execution, trained model quality or production readiness.

findings: First-confirmation semantics prevent hindsight selection of better later scores.
Negative clips and all excluded/tentative tracks remain visible in evaluation accounting.
Matching work is admitted before class/coverage filtering and cancellation never returns a successful partial report.
Legacy closed-gap and hand-computed event metrics remain preserved under the bounded entrypoint.

obligations.work: Run pinned native custody, deployment-opening, CLI parser/process and legacy evaluation integration targets.
Qualify exact trained model generations against retained labelled real corpora, including slice metrics and calibration.

unknowns: Full dependency closure has not compiled here; source review is not executable integration proof.
The initial bounded profile does not evaluate zones, identities, arbitrary clocks, sparse uncertain timestamps, or multi-clip collections.
Retained detector threshold and NMS already discard some detections; the curve cannot reconstruct lower-threshold results.
No new CoverageWitness, camera clock attestation, calibrated confidence or release qualification is created.
invalidations: Changed source/capsule bytes, missing custody, privacy changes, inconsistent tracking facts or failed revalidation refuse.
Any later source/privacy/authority change invalidates treating an old snapshot as current authority.
Broad beads remain open until their registered qualification evidence exists.

continuations.action: Run native integration on a host that can build the unchanged pinned dependency closure.
continuations.expected_proof: Passing custody/opening/CLI tests and legacy regression targets.

continuations.action: Evaluate an exact retained trained model generation against a labelled real corpus.
continuations.authority: Read/evaluate existing authorized data; no automatic model or threshold activation.
continuations.expected_proof: Retained raw candidate outcomes, coverage assumptions, slice metrics and calibration evidence.

continuations.action: Implement provider-authenticated terminal alert delivery/failure reconciliation as a separate feature.
continuations.authority: Requires a concrete provider protocol and existing explicit effect authority.
continuations.expected_proof: Authenticated delivery/failure and lost-ack reconciliation contracts.
